title: Trump 2028 Constitutional and Election-Ledger Hypothesis
question: What legal and procedural gates could a Trump 2028 third-election bid pressure, and what does current law actually permit?
bluf: Current law bars a direct third presidential election after Trump's 2016 and 2024 elections. This developing package steelmans a possible delay-and-pressure strategy across campaign filing, nomination, ballot, elector, congressional-count and Article V gates without attributing that theory to any administration lawyer or treating procedural pressure as a legal cure.
